name: dev-conventions
description: Four on-demand references carrying only what a repo cannot state by being read: where a project's writing lives (a slow-clock home for principles, CLAUDE.md as a routing index rather than an accumulating pile); the house Python pinning policy plus the two mechanical mistakes behind most Pydantic/Pyright diagnostic walls; documentation conventions (last-updated dates, where unshared notes and session logs live, how dependency changes are recorded, and the rule against decorative counts in prose); and that uv and bun both ship a native CVE audit subcommand at all. No hooks and no ambient injection -- conventions belong in each repo's own always-loaded files.
